import unittest
from copy import deepcopy
from codec import parse_event
from reducer import empty_state, apply_event


def apply(state, line):
    return apply_event(state, parse_event(line))


class ApplyEventTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.state = empty_state()
        self.state = apply(self.state, '{"id":"r1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":10}')
        self.state = apply(self.state, '{"id":"r2","op":"restock","sku":"B","qty":2}')

    def _check_detached(self, original, result):
        # Mutating result must not affect original.
        self.assertEqual(original, deepcopy(original))
        result['stock']['NOPE'] = 999
        self.assertNotIn('NOPE', original['stock'])

    def test_restock_adds(self):
        st = apply_event(self.state, parse_event(
            '{"id":"n1","op":"restock","sku":"A","qty":3}'))
        self.assertEqual(st['stock']['A'], 13)
        self.assertEqual(self.state['stock']['A'], 10)  # unchanged

    def test_reserve_deducts(self):
        st = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",4],["B",1]]}')
        self.assertEqual(st['stock']['A'], 6)
        self.assertEqual(st['stock']['B'], 1)
        self.assertEqual(st['requests']['Q'], {'A': 4, 'B': 1})
        # original unchanged
        self.assertEqual(self.state['stock']['A'], 10)

    def test_cancel_restores_and_removes(self):
        st = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",3]]}')
        self.assertIn('Q', st['requests'])
        st2 = apply(st, '{"id":"c1","op":"cancel","request":"Q"}')
        self.assertEqual(st2['stock']['A'], 10)
        self.assertNotIn('Q', st2['requests'])

    def test_request_reuse_after_cancel(self):
        st = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",3]]}')
        st = apply(st, '{"id":"c1","op":"cancel","request":"Q"}')
        # Reuse request id with new event id
        st = apply(st, '{"id":"v2","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",1]]}')
        self.assertEqual(st['requests']['Q'], {'A': 1})
        self.assertEqual(st['stock']['A'], 9)

    def test_seen_replay_equal_event_no_change(self):
        st = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",3]]}')
        before = deepcopy(st)
        replay = apply(st, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",3]]}')
        # stock unchanged after replay, but state detached
        self.assertEqual(replay['stock'], before['stock'])
        self.assertEqual(replay['requests'], before['requests'])
        self._check_detached(st, replay)

    def test_conflicting_same_id_raises(self):
        st = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",3]]}')
        before = deepcopy(st)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            apply(st, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",4]]}')
        self.assertEqual(st, before)

    def test_reserve_unknown_sku_rejected(self):
        before = deepcopy(self.state)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["ZZZ",1]]}')
        self.assertEqual(self.state, before)
        self.assertNotIn('v1', self.state['seen'])

    def test_reserve_insufficient_rejected(self):
        before = deepcopy(self.state)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["B",5]]}')
        self.assertEqual(self.state, before)
        self.assertNotIn('v1', self.state['seen'])

    def test_reserve_duplicate_request_rejected(self):
        st = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",1]]}')
        before = deepcopy(st)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            apply(st, '{"id":"v2","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",1]]}')
        self.assertEqual(st, before)

    def test_cancel_inactive_rejected(self):
        before = deepcopy(self.state)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            apply(self.state, '{"id":"c1","op":"cancel","request":"Q"}')
        self.assertNotIn('c1', self.state['seen'])

    def test_empty_reserve_creates_active_request(self):
        st = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[]}')
        self.assertEqual(st['requests']['Q'], {})
        st2 = apply(st, '{"id":"c1","op":"cancel","request":"Q"}')
        self.assertNotIn('Q', st2['requests'])

    def test_seen_persists_after_cancel(self):
        st = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",1]]}')
        st = apply(st, '{"id":"c1","op":"cancel","request":"Q"}')
        self.assertIn('v1', st['seen'])
        self.assertIn('c1', st['seen'])

    def test_returned_seen_event_detached(self):
        # Note: self.state (from setUp) already holds r1,r2 in seen.
        st = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",1]]}')
        seen_ev = st['seen']['v1']
        # mutate result's seen event; the input state's seen must not gain v1/change
        seen_ev['lines'][0][1] = 999
        self.assertNotIn('v1', self.state['seen'])
        self.assertEqual(self.state['seen']['r1']['qty'], 10)
        # a replay from the original detached input yields an unmutated event value
        replay = apply(self.state, '{"id":"v1","op":"reserve","request":"Q","lines":[["A",1]]}')
        self.assertEqual(replay['seen']['v1']['lines'][0][1], 1)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
